# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router (Resource)

Use the `ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router` resource to create and manage a DE-CIX Cloud ROUTER (VRF) instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_account" "customer" {
  external_ref = "my_account"
}

resource "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router" "example" {
  managing_account  = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  consuming_account = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  billing_account   = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  product_offering  = "1"
  asn               = 65001
  capacity          = 1000
  external_ref      = "my-cloud-router"
}

output "cloud_router_id" {
  value = ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router.example.id
}

output "cloud_router_state" {
  value = ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router.example.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn` (Number) Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Cloud ROUTER
- `billing_account` (String) The account used for billing
- `capacity` (Number) Bandwidth capacity in Mbps
- `consuming_account` (String) The account consuming the Cloud ROUTER service
- `managing_account` (String) The account responsible for managing the Cloud ROUTER
- `product_offering` (String) Product offering ID for the Cloud ROUTER

### Optional

- `charged_until` (String) Service continues incurring charges until this date
- `decommission_at` (String) Service will be decommissioned on this date
- `external_ref` (String) External reference for the Cloud ROUTER
- `metro_area_network` (String) Metro area network where Cloud ROUTER is deployed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String)
- `status` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String)
- `severity` (Number)
- `tag` (String)
- `timestamp` (String)
